mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_WEATHER_ALERT WHERE TRUNC(ALERT_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
DELETE FROM TB_WEATHER_RISK WHERE TRUNC(RISK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ZONE_CD AS "code", ZONE_NM AS "name", PARENT_REGION AS "regionNm", DISTRICT_EXPR AS "districtExpr" FROM TB_ALERT_ZONE_MAP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ZONE_CD

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(REGION_CD), '')), '') AS regionCd, REGION_NM AS regionNm, DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm FROM TB_BLDG_RISK_STATIC WHERE REGION_NM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY REGION_NM, DISTRICT_NM ORDER BY REGION_NM, DISTRICT_NM

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(REGION_CD), '')), '') AS "regionCd", REGION_NM AS "regionNm", DISTRICT_NM AS "districtNm", AVG(LON) AS "avgLon", AVG(LAT) AS "avgLat", MIN(LON) AS "minLon", MAX(LON) AS "maxLon", MIN(LAT) AS "minLat", MAX(LAT) AS "maxLat" FROM TB_BLDG_RISK_STATIC WHERE REGION_NM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY REGION_NM, DISTRICT_NM
